guide.description: A two-layer wavetable synthesizer with a 64-step sequencer and arpeggiator.

controls.action: Start or stop the patch's sequence.
Next of the twelve patches, each with its own pattern.
On the OSC page, sweep the wavetable POSITION.
Edit the four parameters shown on the current page.
Return that parameter to the patch's factory value.
Sequencer start / stop.
Next page: LFO, OSC, MOD, FILTER, ENV, AMP, FX, SEQ, ARP.
Next patch.
Jump to that section; tap again for its second page.
Change it; tap a knob to step it.
Start audio if it stopped.
Play C to C; in ARPEGGIO the held notes are arpeggiated.
Octave down / up.
Switch SOLO (mono with glide) and POLY.
Sustain notes, or latch the arpeggio.
Turn a step on or off (a new step takes the last note played).
Edit the step: notes (chords up to 8), gate, velocity, tie.
Fill the pattern with a random E minor line.
Next patch / restore this patch and pattern to factory.

sections.title: Sound
sections.text: Each voice blends two of sixteen wavetables at one POSITION, then a wave shaper, a filter (LPF, HPF, BPF at 12 or 24 dB, or VINTAGE), three envelopes (OSC, FILTER, AMP; ENV SELECT picks which the faders edit), one LFO, chorus, delay and reverb. Eight voices.

sections.title: Saved settings
sections.text: Edits to all twelve patches and their patterns save automatically and return next time.
